author: shadowolfyt
body:
Hello People of the Avicus Network!
I would like to do a massive recording videos before I go away this week SO! Please comment me your skypes and we can meet up in a call and record a crap tone of Nebula episodes for my channel and your channels too! So add me on Skype (evergamingyt)

EDIT
- Please make sure you have a good microphone (I will not accept anyone that either doesn't have on or has a dodgy one.)
- Make sure your available (I will post the times in here when I see my schedule free at some point this week.)

Check out my Nebula Content on my channel to see how I roll! (youtube.com/shadowolf365)

The reason I want to record with you guys is because I want to help you guys and if you have a channel I want to help you out and help you grow and gain viewers and subscribers!
